items.name: Stockholmsligan 3: Märke - 2026

venue.name: Arena Satelliten
venue.details: Klubben. Entrance through "Entré A", in front of the bus stops. The front door might be locked, but we will open it at regular intervals - contact the organizers if you are stuck outside.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den tredje deltävlingen i höstsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the third competition in the autumn season of Stockholmsligan 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Wolfpack Wednesday NC II 2026
items.information: **This competition does NOT have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event and takes place on a Wednesday evening.** **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCII2026#76282-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WolfpackWednesdayNCII2026#76288-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4MTYxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--af0585c8fc7c8df1b310e5683b32896ba39aa835/image.png)
